name: codex-game-atelier
description: Codex-native workflows backed by a deterministic CLI for supported Godot projects.

interface.shortDescription: Validate and test supported Godot projects.
interface.longDescription: Phase 1 Godot workflows for project inspection, explicit initialization, recorded validation and tests, committed-run diagnostics, and bounded cleanup previews. Build, export, release, and raw log retention are not implemented yet.
defaultPrompt: Inspect this Godot project and report its Atelier readiness.
Validate this initialized project and show the structured result.
Run the fixed GDScript tests after confirming required authorization.
